_note: GDD 3.3 v5.10 revision: tree 112->140->132->128. 128 is the GDD 3.3 floor: the single-jump apex is 126.8px, so anything under 128 could be cleared with one tap and the double-jump lesson collapses. Rock/spike sizes reduced from the 3.3 defaults (32/48/32x24) after playtest — on a 390px-wide screen they read as walls. minGapSec is a time-based floor for hazard spacing so gaps scale with speed.
